mechanism_inventory: msg.sender encoded as originator in payload
cross-chain value/gas mismatch: gasValue = msg.value - _amount; if _amount == msg.value then gasValue = 0 (zero LZ fee)
missing destinationBridges validation — destinationBridges[_dstChainId] may be address(0) if never set
access-control mismatch on bridgeWithPayload/bridge — both public payable, any EOA can bridge for any _toAddress
wrong lifecycle ordering: userDepositing/userIsWithdrawing modifiers not applied to bridge — balanceOf accounting bypassed

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: On ETH-gas chains _bridgeWithPayload computes gasValue = msg.value - _amount. If msg.value == _amount exactly, gasValue = 0 and dcntEth.sendAndCall is called with {value: 0}. If LZ does not revert on zero fee, the cross-chain message is never delivered while WETH was already deposited — permanent loss of user funds with no revert on source chain.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Any EOA calling bridge()/bridgeWithPayload() with msg.value == _amount (zero LZ gas fee) — permissionless.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. bridge(_dstChainId, _toAddress, _amount, _dstGasForCall=0, true) with msg.value = _amount. 2. weth.deposit{value:_amount}() mints WETH to router. 3. gasValue = 0. 4. dcntEth.sendAndCall{value:0}. 5. If LZ doesn't revert on zero fee, message never delivered. 6. User's ETH held as WETH in router with no accounting entry — permanently locked.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Bridge caller loses _amount ETH — locked as WETH in router.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: Nobody directly; funds locked in the contract.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: HIGH/CRITICAL fund-loss path; the zero-gasValue arithmetic is a natural mistake; impact depends on LZ zero-fee behavior (execution-dependent).

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: destinationBridges[_dstChainId] is never validated non-zero. If owner never called addDestinationBridge, destBridge = bytes32(abi.encode(address(0))) and dcntEth.sendAndCall sends to the zero address on destination — funds bridged to an unrecoverable address, permanently lost.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Any EOA calling bridge with an unregistered _dstChainId (accidental user error or griefing).
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. bridge(unregisteredChainId, _toAddress, _amount, ...). 2. destinationBridges[unregisteredChainId]=address(0). 3. WETH deposited / transferFrom executes. 4. dcntEth.sendAndCall sends _amount to address(0) on destination. 5. Funds permanently lost.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Direct fund-loss path, permissionless, distinct locus (destination validation) from gasValue arithmetic.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: Zero gasValue LZ fee — whether dcntEth.sendAndCall reverts or silently drops the message when called with {value:0}
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: gasValue = msg.value - _amount (gasCurrencyIsEth=true); dcntEth.sendAndCall{value: gasValue}; LZ OFT impl not in source.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Does sendAndCall revert on zero native fee or emit a droppable message? Revert => gas-only loss; no-revert => WETH permanently locked.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: Bridge caller loses _amount if LZ doesn't revert.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: balanceOf accounting bypass for bridge callers — bridge/bridgeWithPayload never update balanceOf, but addLiquidityEth does; router holds more WETH than sum(balanceOf) accounts for
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: userDepositing increments balanceOf; bridge() calls weth.deposit{value:_amount}() but never touches balanceOf.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Whether the phantom WETH is extractable (removeLiquidity checks balanceOf[msg.sender]) or only an accounting inconsistency.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: LPs if phantom WETH extracted; or invariant violated even if not.

rejected_mechanisms.mechanism: msg.sender spoofing causing unauthorized fund delivery
rejected_mechanisms.claimed_locus: msg.sender encoded as _from in payload via _getCallParams
rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: Payload encodes msg.sender as _from (actual caller); destination onZetaReceived/onOFTReceived uses _from only as originator identifier; _to is the recipient. Attacker cannot forge a different msg.sender.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Attacker calling bridge() with their own address as _from is expected/correct; no misdirection.

rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: weth.deposit{value:0} is a no-op; zero-token LZ message; attacker pays own LZ fee; griefing destination gas only.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Impact limited to attacker wasting own fees; no victim loses funds; dust/self-funded.

impact_direction.victim_loses: Bridge caller permanently loses bridged ETH/WETH — locked in router (zero-gasValue) or sent to address(0) on destination (unregistered chainId).
impact_direction.invariant_violated: Cross-chain value correctness: every bridge call must deliver the bridged amount to the intended recipient.
